Target must be a reachable living rooted plant with an accessible soil/root zone; water must be real, accessible, usable freshwater controlled by the actor, and quantity must be positive and no greater than available water and carrier capacity. Require a physically suitable held carrier; a directly usable water-bearing container may satisfy both arguments. Neither water nor containers are supplied by review. No such supplies are established by this packet. Bind acquisition and carrying to existing implementation functions if available; otherwise include the minimal usable-water collection/transport dependency in this same handoff, with actual source depletion and finite carrier capacity, not a free water source or a separate activity roadmap. Do not expose undiscovered sources.
Study takes 3 simulation rounds, with ordinary metabolism and no material consumption. Execution requires two work rounds per started litre, with at most one litre per execution and 2 energy total per litre, charged proportionally to actual work. Movement and acquisition are separate actions with their existing costs. Hold the selected water against double use while work is pending; apply the measured dose only on completed execution after revalidating reach, carrier, target and water. Output is the transferred water in the target soil, with any physically rejected portion recorded as runoff or drainage; debit precisely that amount from the carrier. Never create berries, nutrients, soil fertility, plant capacity or new plants from watering.
Implementation must bind to the existing soil-moisture and growth update code, using its units, infiltration, capacity, drainage and waterlogging behavior. If the current soil model has no conserved water input, implement that minimal missing connection in this handoff: define and publish root-zone storage capacity in litres, convert retained litres to normalized moisture using that capacity, and account for overflow, drainage and subsequent evaporation. A finite documented capacity is required before execution; do not select a hidden arbitrary moisture boost. Changes to the shared soil zone affect all plants actually rooted there and must not be duplicated per target. No automatic boost to growth merely because this ability was used. Existing plant growth code remains responsible for any later growth, within its stock capacity and environmental/resource limits; missing growth requirements must be resolved in the handoff rather than inferred from stock differences. No fixed successful growth delay is established: watering takes the stated work time, while biological outcomes require subsequent actual simulation time and observations.
Use probe for a baseline and later observations; its existing costs and handler are reused, not reimplemented. At reported moisture 0.65 with no observed drought, the safe initial practice is observation and restraint, not compulsory dosing. Water only where measured conditions and the implemented plant tolerances justify it; otherwise a no-op or refusal reports why and produces no success event. Maintenance is conditional reinspection and individually initiated watering when needed, not an autonomous schedule. Watering can fail to improve growth or worsen waterlogging. Propagation is outside this minimal operation and is not asserted possible for this plant.
Persist actor, resolved target and soil-zone identity, carrier, reserved water, completed work, charged energy and status. Interruption pauses unfinished work; resume revalidates prerequisites. Cancellation releases surviving reserved water exactly once without refunding time or energy; no completed transfer is reversed. Actor death stops active work and releases surviving water through normal item/death handling, not by duplicating it. Environmental changes can invalidate or degrade pending inputs. Completed soil changes continue through ordinary world updates even if the actor leaves or dies. Development/review waiting advances no world time.
Exact evidence references: commons-berry-0-0; lin record commons-berry-0-0:observed-state, tick 14, evidence event-14-lin-145; owned berry stack item-6-lin-57 is food, not an established water supply or propagation material. Reuse registry IDs probe, gather, navigate, pickup, wait and learn only for their existing functions and contracts; forest.wait is the supplied wait handler. Record the actual reused handlers/modules and new water-input bindings in implementation provenance. Do not claim their code as reinvention. Do not alter reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.

Minimal mechanism: controlled supported impacts followed by manual removal of accessible loose casing; no cutting, cooking, toxin removal or eating. Preconditions: living actor able to manipulate material, sufficient energy, target under exclusive work reservation and within 0.65 m, an actually owned suitable hard blunt striker, and a stable accessible support within reach.
